note: FROZEN fixture — the hermetic stand-in for the deploy-generated dist/content/fallback.json (DR-014 item 6; A2 §1 P3). Client commit contract (src/content.ts parseFallback): as_of non-empty (deploy stamps YYYY-MM-DD), numeric content_version, blocks including the mandatory 'site.disclaimer' block (red line 5 / Q50 — a payload without it NEVER commits), slots optional. Slot text is printable-ASCII <=700 (client drops violators), so values carrying typographic glyphs live in BLOCKS, which the frozen viewer assertions pin verbatim. A prose string may migrate out of the baked page ONLY if this fixture serves it (SPEC section Re-freeze R2).

atlas.explorer.potential-banner.text: POTENTIAL crisis — the peak is anchored at today (Jul 2026) by construction, not as a forecast. All lines end at t0 and the right half of the axis is intentionally empty: no forward projection. Backfill uses real market anchors (Jul 2021 → Jul 2026); current-state sources are ≤ 6 weeks old (BIS 28 Jun · ECB 2 Jun & 27 May · Fed 8 May 2026). Safe-haven candidates are shown dashed.

site.aggregate.methodology.text: Each line is a weighted cross-crisis composite, rebased to 100 at the common peak: how the asset class folds its own crisis shape into the peak and the historical aftermath that follows it. Bitcoin (falsified) is excluded.
